current_stage_search_contract.rule: The calibration must perform literal matching against the text value already present in the synthetic excerpt. No implicit case folding, stemming, fuzzy matching, spelling normalization, historical variant expansion or semantic expansion is allowed.
current_stage_search_contract.query_provenance: Record the user/query string exactly as executed plus explicit match mode, filters, corpus boundary and implementation/version.
current_stage_search_contract.corpus_boundary: The calibration corpus is only the explicitly supplied synthetic provider-neutral state/fixture. The test fixture is not promoted into canonical Research State.
current_stage_search_contract.result_boundary: A hit reports existing provenance references; it is not a Finding, Claim or entity assertion.

forbidden_loss: loss of query/corpus/version provenance needed to explain a rerun
implicit normalization or variant expansion presented as exact matching
promotion of test/derived fixture content into canonical research truth
promotion of hit/no-hit into historical Finding or completeness claim
introduction of provider path/key as canonical internal identity

acceptance_tests.statement: The existing synthetic excerpt text is found by a literal exact query that occurs in it.
acceptance_tests.expected: one or more stable hit records with the existing excerpt/findspot and parent provenance references

acceptance_tests.statement: A literal query absent from the synthetic corpus returns no hits.
acceptance_tests.expected: empty hit set; no Finding/Claim/negative historical conclusion is created

acceptance_tests.statement: The same query against the same declared corpus boundary produces the same query-log parameters and equivalent hit provenance.
Each hit round-trips from excerpt/findspot through derivative/instance/representation/source using only existing fixture relations.
acceptance_tests.expected: no inferred IDs or newly invented state

acceptance_tests.statement: Exact search runs with no LLM/semantic retrieval dependency.
acceptance_tests.expected: tests succeed with only local deterministic Python code

acceptance_tests.statement: An allowed equality filter (for example source_id or instance_id) deterministically restricts the hit set and is reproduced in the query log.
acceptance_tests.expected: only hits satisfying the explicit existing-ID filter; no inferred identity

acceptance_tests.statement: The same JSON-compatible input state deterministically yields the same corpus_fingerprint; a changed input state yields a different fingerprint.
acceptance_tests.expected: SHA-256 corpus fingerprint makes rerun boundary explicit without becoming canonical research identity

negative_tests.statement: Different case or other normalization is not silently treated as the same literal query.
negative_tests.expected: no match unless that exact character sequence exists; any future normalization requires a separate explicit mode/decision

negative_tests.statement: A hit with missing/invalid provenance cannot be silently repaired by inference.
negative_tests.expected: fail closed or surface explicit missing/unresolved according to existing contract

negative_tests.statement: Real Sachenbacher audit projection is not accepted as searchable corpus merely because its provenance chain is real.
negative_tests.expected: no real-source verification claim or real-corpus fixture added

negative_tests.statement: Implementation does not create persistent index/database/state.
An unknown filter key or a matching excerpt whose required provenance cannot be resolved is not silently accepted.
negative_tests.expected: fail closed with an explicit retrieval error

negative_tests.statement: An empty query is rejected rather than treated as matching every excerpt.
negative_tests.expected: fail closed with an explicit retrieval error

coverage_claim_limit: At most mark the literal exact-search/filter/query-provenance implementation as partial/in-progress until the real source falsification stage succeeds. Do not mark REQ-RET-001, REQ-RET-003 or REQ-SRC-004 verified from the synthetic calibration alone.

implementation_shape.status: bounded calibration choice; reversible; not a durable product-package decision
implementation_shape.test_fixture_rule: Product code must not import from tests. If reuse of the existing full synthetic audit state is needed, move only that synthetic fixture construction into tools/operational/tests/fixtures.py and make both audit/retrieval tests consume it; do not create a new canonical state or product schema.

input_contract.state: existing provider-neutral mapping with collections already used by audit.py; JSON-compatible for this calibration so the input can be deterministically fingerprinted
input_contract.searchable_records: only excerpts with an explicit non-empty `text` value
input_contract.corpus_ref: non-empty caller-supplied identifier for the current synthetic corpus boundary
input_contract.filters: optional equality filters over existing provenance IDs only

implementation_shape.filter_rule: Equality only. Unknown filter keys fail closed. Filters do not infer missing ancestry.
implementation_shape.matching_rule: Calibration mode is case-sensitive literal substring/phrase matching over excerpt.text. No tokenization, Unicode normalization, case folding, stemming, fuzzy matching or historical expansion. This deliberately proves only the deterministic literal baseline and does not claim full final word-search semantics.

output_contract.side_effects: none; query log and hits are returned values, not persisted state

implementation_shape.provenance_rule: A matching excerpt is a valid hit only when the required explicit findspot and ancestry can be resolved through existing state links. Missing required provenance fails closed with a retrieval error; it is never repaired by inference.
implementation_shape.persistence: none beyond code/tests/required #63 trace and proportional #59 coverage
implementation_shape.corpus_fingerprint_rule: Return sha256 over UTF-8 bytes of deterministic JSON serialization of the complete input state using ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true and compact separators. This is run/corpus provenance only, not canonical Source/Instance identity.
